top_signals.title: Nebraska troopers seize record $50M drug load from semi on Interstate 80
top_signals.summary:
A commercial vehicle inspection in Dawson County uncovered the largest drug seizure by volume in Nebraska State Patrol history.

The post Nebraska troopers seize record $50M drug load from semi on Interstate 80 appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Glencore Sued For $2 Billion; Accuses Radiant World of Fraud
top_signals.summary: Glencore Plc has accused Radiant World and associated companies of sending falsified invoices to lenders — just as the embattled group of traders filed a suit in Singapore seeking more than $2 billion in damages from Glencore.
